cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.
